characters_present: No clearly visible individual characters; only environmental and animal life are shown.
The Metabunker is depicted as a major object/location.
continuity_links: This page functions as an establishing introduction to Planet Perdita and the Metabunker's placement there.
dialogue_meaning: The narration describes Perdita as an extreme-gravity world with a fog-covered, rocky and muddy environment.
It explains that the Metabunker was dragged down by gravity and became lodged in the landscape.
It emphasizes that native life has adapted to the planet's harsh gravity, including enormous mushrooms and flattened crawling animals.
locations: The granite surface of the planet
lore_facts: Planet Perdita is located in the lower system.
Perdita is described as a small orb made of granite and mud and covered by fog.
Perdita has an immense gravity field.
A structure called the Metabunker was sucked in by that gravity and sank halfway into a muddy lake.
Mushrooms on the planet can grow to about 160 feet high.
The planet's surface hosts voracious, flat-bodied animals that struggle to move under the strong gravity.
plot_events: The narration introduces Planet Perdita in the lower system as a small world of granite and mud hidden by fog.
The Metabunker is pulled down by the planet's enormous gravity and ends up half-submerged in a muddy lake.
The page establishes the planet's hostile ecosystem, including towering mushrooms and flat-bodied animals struggling across the ground.
visual_summary: An opening narration page introduces the planet Perdita. Panels show a fog-shrouded rocky world in space, a massive geometric structure called the Metabunker sinking into a muddy lake under extreme gravity, and a harsh surface landscape with giant mushrooms and low, crawling fauna around the partially embedded structure.
